item.value: npm `trellis` (trentbrew/trellis, Trent Brew/turtle.tech, solo): closest conceptual rival found to date. Event-sourced causal graph + decision traces AUTO-CAPTURED from MCP tool calls (src/decisions/types.ts: rationale, alternatives, confidence, relatedEntities, pre/post hooks) — genuinely execution-coupled provenance. Has branch/merge state, graph-native issues/milestones, local-first. LACKS: judging/merge-by-metric, bi-temporal valid-time/supersede, typed-edge DAG dispatch. 0 stars, 42 versions Mar-Jun 2026, shipped v3.2.2 on 2026-06-10. Verdict WATCH; re-check in 4-6 weeks.

PyPI `weft` (VanL/weft, Van Lindberg of modelmonster.ai — famous OSS attorney): durable task substrate (Temporal-lite for agents), 81 releases since Feb 2026, ~8.5k dl/mo, 0 stars, near 1.0. No knowledge graph/memory by design. KEY SIGNAL: his repo's private dev harness (.agents/skills/gstack/) contains SELF_LEARNING_V0.md + llm-judge.ts + benchmark-judge.ts + learnings injection — he hand-built our flagship self-learning loop as internal tooling but didn't productize it. Watch modelmonster.ai.

Category-formation evidence (Feb-Jun 2026): >=5 independent tiny entrants shipped packages using our vocabulary — trellis (causal graph+decision traces), weft (durable task substrate), @tangle-network/agent-knowledge (eval-gated knowledge growth + research loop), lamarck by johnlindquist (session transcripts -> LLM reflection -> MEMORY.md with candidate/established/proven lifecycle + 90-day feedback decay; abandoned Feb 2026), systemic-engineering/cairn (witnessed agent sessions, content-addressed). NONE combines bi-temporal supersede + typed-edge DAG handoff + merge-by-metric. Moats 1/2/3 uncontested as a system; moat 4 has a live rival in trellis.

Positioning: the durable-execution substrate layer is already contested by big cos (Microsoft Durable Task for AI Agents, DBOS, Orkes) — do NOT position the orchestrator as 'durable tasks'. The knowledge/decision-graph + judging layer above it has no major entrant. Open-source timing urgent: first-with-receipts window is months; claim the terms (decision provenance, merge-by-metric, execution-coupled memory) in README/launch before any swarm entrant crosses ~500 stars.
